raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 1
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner began with the incorrect assumption that Microsoft authored Atari BASIC, misidentifying the company in the clue. This flawed premise set the analysis on the wrong track and later led to a further misdirection toward MAC/65/OSS (Stephen D. Lawrow) instead of the correct cartridge-based system from Shepardson Microsystems (Atari Assembler Editor) programmed by Kathleen O’Brien.
